mapper.insert: INSERT INTO video ( title, description, file_name, file_path, thumbnail, duration, course_id, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{title}, #{description}, #{fileName}, #{filePath}, #{thumbnail}, #{duration}, #{courseId}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE video SET title = #{title}, description = #{description}, file_name = #{fileName}, file_path = #{filePath}, thumbnail = #{thumbnail}, duration = #{duration}, course_id = #{courseId}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, title, description, file_name, file_path, thumbnail, duration, course_id, created_at, updated_at FROM video WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, title, description, file_name, file_path, thumbnail, duration, course_id, created_at, updated_at FROM video WHERE course_id = #{courseId}
